question: Why can teacher not save the module Timetable (Syntax error) in UntisX?
answer: Check the role (teacher) and the permissions. Module Timetable may require admin/teacher. Error Syntax error: on 401/403 check credentials, on 404 check the route in App.tsx, on 500 check server logs, on timeout check the network and Docker container. Validate the endpoint and database connection.
